entries.title: Canadian Healthcare System: Structure, Funding, and Delivery

mcc_evidence.objective_title: Concepts of health and its determinants
mcc_evidence.official_source: research/mcc/objectives_registry.json (retrieved from official MCC Objectives Online Web Service)
mcc_evidence.mapping_rationale: Objective covers 'concepts of health, wellness, illness, disease' and 'determinants of health'; system-level structure/funding/delivery is adjacent but not identical to this objective's own focus on individual-level health concepts.

testable_competencies.system_navigation: Describe the basic structure, funding model (public single-payer for medically necessary services), and delivery mechanisms of the Canadian healthcare system.

clinical_source_organizations: Government of Canada / Department of Justice

entries.title: Legal Foundation of Canadian Healthcare

mcc_evidence.official_source: research/mcc/objectives_registry.json (retrieved from official MCC Objectives Online Web Service)
mcc_evidence.mapping_rationale: Objective's rationale explicitly states: 'Knowledge of the legal system in Canada allows the physician to provide care to patients in the context of federal, provincial or territorial, and local laws and regulations.' Directly matches this unit's content.

testable_competencies.legal_professional_action: Identify which level of government/legal authority (federal vs. provincial/territorial) governs a given healthcare legal question.

clinical_source_organizations: Government of Canada / Department of Justice

entries.title: History of the Canadian Healthcare System and Crown-Indigenous Relations

mcc_evidence.official_source: research/mcc/objectives_registry.json (retrieved from official MCC Objectives Online Web Service)
mcc_evidence.mapping_rationale: Objective's rationale explicitly requires responding to TRC Calls to Action; historical context is foundational but this unit itself is historical/contextual literacy rather than the objective's own clinical-encounter focus.

mcc_evidence.official_source: research/mcc/objectives_registry.json (retrieved from official MCC Objectives Online Web Service)
mcc_evidence.mapping_rationale: Objective explicitly names colonialism and the TRC Calls to Action as foundational context for anti-oppressive care.

testable_competencies.ethical_reasoning: Articulate how the history of the Canadian healthcare system and Crown-Indigenous relations informs current health inequities.

clinical_source_organizations: Truth and Reconciliation Commission of Canada

mcc_evidence.objective_title: Leader/Manager - Effectively manage practice and career
mcc_evidence.official_source: research/mcc/objectives_registry.json (role-level record; no per-objective ID exists for this role)
mcc_evidence.mapping_rationale: Group's enabling text: 'Abide by the regulatory requirements governing medical office practice' - generically covers regulatory compliance but does not explicitly name licensure/certification processes.

testable_competencies.system_navigation: Recognize the role of the LMCC and provincial/territorial medical regulatory authorities in physician licensure.

mcc_evidence.objective_title: Leader/Manager - Participate appropriately in the health care system
mcc_evidence.official_source: research/mcc/objectives_registry.json (role-level record; no per-objective ID exists for this role)
mcc_evidence.mapping_rationale: Group's enabling text explicitly names 'professional associations' as one of the bodies whose role the candidate must describe: 'Describe the roles of physicians in developing and supporting the health care system (including health and prevention, advocacy groups, regulatory bodies, professional associations).'

testable_competencies.system_navigation: Identify the distinct roles of the CMA, provincial medical associations, and specialty societies.

entries.title: Introduction to the Principles of Ethics

testable_competencies.ethical_reasoning: Apply the four principles of biomedical ethics (autonomy, beneficence, non-maleficence, justice) to frame a clinical ethics question.

mcc_evidence.objective_title: Communicator - Effectively convey oral and written information associated with a medical encounter
mcc_evidence.official_source: research/mcc/objectives_registry.json (role-level record; no per-objective ID exists for this role)
mcc_evidence.mapping_rationale: Group's enabling text explicitly covers confidentiality: 'Adhere to the ethical and legal requirements of confidentiality in all professional communication', 'Maintain confidentiality of medical records', 'Know the exceptions to confidentiality and when it must or may be breached (e.g., duty to warn or report, child abuse, notifiable diseases)'.

testable_competencies.legal_professional_action: Maintain patient confidentiality and recognize the recognized exceptions (duty to warn, mandatory reporting).
testable_competencies.communication: Disclose information only with appropriate consent or legal authority.

entries.title: Consent and Capacity

mcc_evidence.official_source: research/mcc/objectives_registry.json (retrieved from official MCC Objectives Online Web Service)
mcc_evidence.mapping_rationale: Objective's key_objectives text explicitly names capacity: 'taking into account issues related to decision-making capacity, information sharing, the form of consent, limitations, and exceptions to the requirement of consent.'

testable_competencies.assessment: Assess decision-making capacity for a specific decision.
testable_competencies.legal_professional_action: Determine the appropriate consent process, including for incapable patients (substitute decision-maker).

clinical_source_organizations: provincial/territorial legislation (e.g., health care consent acts)

mcc_evidence.official_source: research/mcc/objectives_registry.json (retrieved from official MCC Objectives Online Web Service)
mcc_evidence.mapping_rationale: Direct title and content match: objective covers standard of care, harm, and appropriate action when negligence is reported or suspected.

testable_competencies.legal_professional_action: Recognize a potential negligence/standard-of-care concern and determine appropriate next steps.

mcc_evidence.official_source: research/mcc/objectives_registry.json (retrieved from official MCC Objectives Online Web Service)
mcc_evidence.mapping_rationale: Direct title and content match: 'the candidate must honestly and accurately convey relevant information and explanations to patients, their families and other members of the health care team.'

testable_competencies.communication: Honestly and accurately disclose information, including medical error, to patients and families.

entries.title: Reproductive Technologies

mcc_evidence.official_source: research/mcc/objectives_registry.json (retrieved from official MCC Objectives Online Web Service)
mcc_evidence.mapping_rationale: Reproductive technology use requires the same general consent framework this objective covers, but assisted human reproduction is not itself named in the objective's content.

testable_competencies.ethical_reasoning: Apply informed consent principles to reproductive technology decisions (e.g., IVF, surrogacy, gamete donation).

clinical_source_organizations: Government of Canada / Department of Justice (Assisted Human Reproduction Act)

entries.title: End-of-Life Care

mcc_evidence.official_source: research/mcc/objectives_registry.json (retrieved from official MCC Objectives Online Web Service)
mcc_evidence.mapping_rationale: Objective's key_objectives text explicitly requires: 'The candidate must know the provisions in Canadian law on medical assistance in dying (MAID), be prepared to discuss them with patients, and respond appropriately to such requests.'

testable_competencies.assessment: Develop a goals-of-care plan for a dying patient.
testable_competencies.legal_professional_action: Know the provisions of Canadian MAID law and respond appropriately to a MAID request.
testable_competencies.communication: Discuss end-of-life options with patients and families.

clinical_source_organizations: Government of Canada / Department of Justice (Criminal Code MAID provisions)

mcc_evidence.official_source: research/mcc/objectives_registry.json (role-level record; no per-objective ID exists for this role)
mcc_evidence.mapping_rationale: Group's enabling text directly covers this unit's content: 'Abide by the profession's rules, regulations, and ethical codes', 'Recognise and respond to unprofessional and unethical behaviours in physicians and other health professional colleagues', 'Participate in peer assessment, teaching, and standard setting'.

testable_competencies.legal_professional_action: Recognize unprofessional conduct and determine an appropriate response, including reporting obligations.

mcc_evidence.objective_title: Scholar - Apply principles of research and information management to learning and practice
mcc_evidence.official_source: research/mcc/objectives_registry.json (role-level record; no per-objective ID exists for this role)
mcc_evidence.mapping_rationale: Group's enabling text covers evaluating information quality including 'conformity to ethical standards', but this is about appraising existing research, not conducting ethically-approved research (REB approval, research consent) - a genuine but indirect link.

testable_competencies.ethical_reasoning: Recognize the requirement for research ethics board approval and informed consent in human research.

mcc_evidence.objective_title: Leader/Manager - Effectively manage practice and career
mcc_evidence.official_source: research/mcc/objectives_registry.json (role-level record; no per-objective ID exists for this role)
mcc_evidence.mapping_rationale: Group's enabling text directly names this: 'Avoid conflicts of interest by maintaining ethical relations with the industry, suppliers and other medically relevant groups.'

testable_competencies.legal_professional_action: Recognize and appropriately manage conflicts of interest arising from industry relationships.

mcc_evidence.objective_title: Leader/Manager - Allocate health care resources effectively
mcc_evidence.official_source: research/mcc/objectives_registry.json (role-level record; no per-objective ID exists for this role)
mcc_evidence.mapping_rationale: Exact title match with the group's own name: 'Allocate health care resources effectively', covering utilizing resources 'prudently and economically', 'equitably and without bias', and 'in an ethical and informed manner, while balancing individual and societal needs.'

testable_competencies.ethical_reasoning: Apply principles of equitable and ethical resource allocation in a scenario of scarcity.

entries.title: Conscientious Objection

testable_competencies.ethical_reasoning: Balance a physician's own conscientious objection with the duty to provide timely patient access/effective referral.

entries.uncertain_reason: No MCC objective (Medical Expert or role-level) was found that explicitly or substantially addresses conscientious objection. Professional role's 'Integrity' group covers general ethical conduct but does not name this topic. Flagged UNCERTAIN rather than force-mapped to a weakly-related objective.

entries.title: Clinical Informatics and Digital Health Ethics

mcc_evidence.official_source: research/mcc/objectives_registry.json (retrieved from official MCC Objectives Online Web Service)
mcc_evidence.mapping_rationale: Direct title match. Objective's rationale explicitly covers 'electronic health records [EHRs], virtual care, and advanced analytics [e.g., artificial intelligence and machine learning]'.

testable_competencies.system_navigation: Use health information systems safely, recognizing their limitations.
testable_competencies.ethical_reasoning: Recognize ethical considerations in digital health technology use (e.g., AI-assisted decision-making, EHR privacy).

entries.title: History and Impact of Colonialism, and the Movement Towards Reconciliation

mcc_evidence.official_source: research/mcc/objectives_registry.json (retrieved from official MCC Objectives Online Web Service)
mcc_evidence.mapping_rationale: Objective's rationale explicitly names colonialism and 'responding to the calls to action from the Truth and Reconciliation Commission of Canada' as foundational.

mcc_evidence.official_source: research/mcc/objectives_registry.json (retrieved from official MCC Objectives Online Web Service)
mcc_evidence.mapping_rationale: Objective's rationale explicitly requires responding to 'the Calls to Action of the Truth and Reconciliation Commission' and understanding 'root causes of the inequitable health care and health outcomes experienced by Indigenous Peoples'.

testable_competencies.ethical_reasoning: Articulate how colonialism's historical impact and the TRC's Calls to Action inform current clinical and system-level practice.

clinical_source_organizations: Truth and Reconciliation Commission of Canada

mcc_evidence.official_source: research/mcc/objectives_registry.json (retrieved from official MCC Objectives Online Web Service)
mcc_evidence.mapping_rationale: Objective's key_objectives text explicitly requires demonstrating 'an awareness of the root causes of the inequitable health care and health outcomes experienced by Indigenous Peoples' and applying 'population health principles in understanding and advocating for Indigenous Peoples' health'.

testable_competencies.health_advocacy: Recognize structural/social determinants driving disproportionate disease burden in Indigenous populations.
testable_competencies.ethical_reasoning: Provide anti-racist, culturally safe, trauma-informed care.

entries.title: Indigenous Health Coverage and Jurisdictions

mcc_evidence.official_source: research/mcc/objectives_registry.json (retrieved from official MCC Objectives Online Web Service)
mcc_evidence.mapping_rationale: Objective's key_objectives text explicitly requires the candidate to 'articulate the inherent Indigenous and Treaty Rights (e.g., Medicine Chest Clause) relevant to the health of Indigenous Peoples' and apply population health principles at 'institutional' and 'societal' levels - directly covers coverage/jurisdiction content.

testable_competencies.system_navigation: Navigate jurisdictional health coverage gaps affecting Indigenous patients (e.g., Jordan's Principle, NIHB).

clinical_source_organizations: Government of Canada / Indigenous Services Canada
entries.cross_discipline_note: Shares strong conceptual overlap with PHELO's population-health/jurisdiction content and with Pediatrics (Jordan's Principle specifically concerns children); Toronto Notes places the core content here in ELOM.

entries.title: Resources in Indigenous Health
entries.zero_question_reason: Pointer to a resource list, not independent testable content.

entries.title: Canadian Legal System Framework (Criminal/Civil/Administrative Law)

mcc_evidence.official_source: research/mcc/objectives_registry.json (retrieved from official MCC Objectives Online Web Service)
mcc_evidence.mapping_rationale: Objective's rationale explicitly covers 'federal, provincial or territorial, and local laws and regulations' - directly matches this unit's criminal/civil/administrative and jurisdiction-varies-by-province framework.

testable_competencies.legal_professional_action: Distinguish criminal, civil, and administrative legal consequences of a given act, and recognize that criminal law is national while civil/administrative law varies by province/territory.

clinical_source_organizations: Government of Canada / Department of Justice
